name: civfix-app
description: civfix consumer plane: the @civfix/tokens design tokens, the @civfix/ui component set, the community web app and the community mobile app.

pnpm.//overrides: The react, react-dom and react-native entries pin the Expo SDK set. Each range entry forces a patched release of a transitive package whose parent still declares a vulnerable range, held inside the major its parent asks for with two exceptions: postcss-selector-parser@6 goes to 7.1.6, the only fixed line (tailwindcss 3 and postcss-nested; the generated CSS was diffed byte-identical across the move), and uuid goes to 11 under xcode, which asks for ^7 in the iOS prebuild path and only calls v4(). undici is scoped per major because @expo/cli wants 6, miniflare pins 7 exactly and jsdom wants 8. Drop each entry once its parent ships the fixed range itself.
pnpm.//auditConfig: Each ignore has no fix our tree can take and no untrusted input reaching it. GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv (node-forge RSA signature verification) has no patched release; @expo/cli uses node-forge to parse the developer's own keychain certificates in expo run:ios and, through @expo/code-signing-certificates, to sign and verify expo-updates manifests, which the app never configures (no updates block in app.config.js, expo-updates not installed), so no untrusted signature is ever verified. Remove once node-forge ships a release above 1.4.0 or @expo/cli drops it. GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq and GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr: image-size 1 in the metro 0.83.3 that @expo/metro 54 pins exactly; 2.x drops the file-path input metro passes, and metro only measures image assets from this repo and lockfile-pinned packages at build time. Remove with Expo SDK 55 (@expo/metro 55.1 runs metro 0.83.8, which has no image-size). GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr: decode-uri-component 0.5 is ESM-only while query-string 7 (react-navigation 7) require()s it as a function; expo-router always supplies its own getStateFromPath and only calls query-string stringify, never its decoder. Remove with react-navigation 8, whose core no longer depends on query-string.
